title: What your customers see
summary: From finding you to their booking pass: what a customer sees, step by step. No app, no account.

steps.title: They find you
steps.body: From your link in your bio, a message from you, your business card's QR, or Tikka's search, where they look for a service near them and see a map.

steps.title: They pick a service and a time
steps.body: They choose a service and any choices or extras, and see the total. Only your free times show. If a day is full, they can join your waitlist. If you go to customers, they add their address and see your travel fee.

steps.title: They pay the deposit, if you take one
steps.body: Before they pay, they see the deposit, what's left to pay at your shop, and your booking rules. They pay by card or bank transfer through Paystack.

steps.title: They get a booking pass
steps.body: Their pass shows the time, the service, what they've paid and your address, with a button to message you on WhatsApp. With 24 hours' notice they can move the booking from the pass and keep their deposit.

tips: Customers never need an app or an account. Their WhatsApp number is how you both know who they are.
